subject: Salesforce calendar lock + cleanup: final sweep for close-date accuracy
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Salesforce calendar lock + cleanup: final sweep for close-date accuracy

Team —

Finance is asking for a final FY close-date hygiene pass. We need a tight calendar-lock for all deals currently in Commit/Propose stages so we can finalize the forecast this week. Please treat this as high priority and action the items below by end of day Friday (May 21).

What I need from each owner (quick checklist):
- If you have a signed PO or signed SOW, set Stage = "Commit" and ensure Close Date is the contractual date.
- If you do NOT have written confirmation, move the opp to "Best Case" (or Best Case -> At Risk) and add a one-line note with the reason.
- Remove tentative close dates pushed out more than 30 days without activity; mark those opps as "Stale" and add the tag salesops:stale.
- For deals > $100k, confirm that opportunities are linked to the customer contract record and add the legal/procurement contact in the Contact field.

I've attached a CSV extract (Q2-ops-extract-vk.csv) with filters pre-applied (Stage in [Proposal, Commit, Negotiation], Close Date between 2027-05-01 and 2027-09-30). Use the "Owner Review" column to record changes you make.

If you run into blocked opps (procurement redlines, legal delays, security questionnaires outstanding), flag them in Slack #forecast-esc with the HubSpot deal id and I will escalate.

Thanks — this reduces noise for finance and prevents us from over-allocating capacity next quarter.

— Vivek
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Q2-ops-extract-vk.csv (CSV)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Salesforce calendar lock + cleanup: final sweep for close-date accuracy

Vivek — thanks for the extract and clear ask. Quick update from my side after a first pass (details in attached annotated-opps-flagged.xlsx):

Summary of changes I made:
- Moved 7 opps out of Commit into Best Case (no signed docs; emailed buyer thread linked in notes).
- Cleared two duplicate pipeline entries (Acct: Novus Labs).
- Normalized close-dates for three large deals where the contract has a fixed start date (moved close date to 2027-06-30).

Open items I need help with:
- HelixHealth (HS-48219) — account says verbal go-ahead, procurement wants an updated SOW. I cc'd the buyer in my notes but need legal to push SOW. Leaving as Best Case for now.
- One deal (Deal 2345-SS) shows CFO approval but no signed PO in Salesforce files. Ben/SDR to confirm.

I'll continue the sweep this afternoon and will drop final owner updates into the CSV under the "Owner Review" column.

— Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: annotated-opps-flagged.xlsx (XLSX)]

All — good progress. A couple quick notes after reviewing the updated CSV:

Outstanding (owner action required):
- HelixHealth (HS-48219) — Marissa, please attach the buyer email thread and tag Legal. I'll open a JIRA to get an expedited SOW draft (JIRA: SALESOPS-1783).
- Deal 9876-AC (Acct: NovaGrid) — missing procurement contact. Ben, please confirm by EOD Monday or I will mark the opp At Risk for the forecast.
- 4 small opps (> $25k and < $100k) where sales activity is nil for >45 days — recommend archive unless the owner commits to follow-up this week.

Deadline: Monday, May 24, 11:59pm PT. If I don't see owner confirmations in the CSV by then I will set Stage = "At Risk" and tag the deal with salesops:autoprune.

Thanks for moving quickly on this — this will keep our Q2 numbers honest and prevent last-minute surprises for Finance.

— Karthik
Director, Sales Operations
